header.title: System Settings
header.tip: Dynamic configuration is stored in the database and takes precedence over appsettings.json. Leave a field empty to use the default value from the configuration file.

global.title: Global Switches
global.description: Controls overall system behavior. Changes take effect immediately.

pizzaHelper.title: Genshin Pizza Helper
pizzaHelper.description: Upstream configuration for Spiral Abyss data sync. Update here when the Cookie/Salt expires.

afdian.title: Afdian SKU Mapping
afdian.description: Product IDs used for order matching. Update here when products change.

maintenanceMode.label: Maintenance Mode
maintenanceMode.hint: When enabled, all non-admin endpoints return a maintenance response

registrationEnabled.label: Allow Registration
registrationEnabled.hint: When disabled, new users cannot register passport accounts

captchaEnabled.label: Enable Captcha
captchaEnabled.hint: When disabled, login/registration no longer verifies reCaptcha

skuGachaLog.label: Wish Log SKU
skuGachaLog.hint: SKU ID of the wish log service in Afdian orders

skuCdn.label: CDN Service SKU
skuCdn.hint: SKU ID of the CDN service in Afdian 2 orders

diagnosticEmail.label: Diagnostic Email
diagnosticEmail.hint: Email address that receives system exception and order diagnostic notifications
